summary: Application, fee payment, and contactless online road safety test for 6-month Learner's Driving License.

steps.title: Apply on Parivahan Sarathi
steps.description: Select State, authenticate via Aadhaar OTP, and select license classes (e.g. Motorcycle with Gear MCWG, LMV).

steps.title: Watch mandatory road safety tutorial
steps.description: Watch 10-minute animated road safety video on safe driving practices and traffic signs.

steps.title: Pay government LL fee
steps.description: Pay application and online test fee via integrated payment portal.

steps.title: Appear in online proctored STALL test
steps.description: Take 15-question multiple choice test on traffic signs from home device using webcam facial recognition.

steps.title: Instant Learner License download
steps.description: Upon scoring 60%+ correct answers, download Form 3 Learner License valid for 6 months across India.
